## Log lines: in-line colours and indents (2026-10-26)

- `1e xx` stays in the line through the expander (FUN_100c1650) and is drawn by FUN_10162140 (both logs, rem4line,
  spoolmsg, the op 0x24 options): the running colour becomes FUN_10161fd0(xx), xx < 0x11 from the 17-entry table
  0x103353c8 (0 = the line's own colour: 1e 00 / 01 / 09..10), else the colour-id table; the code colour replaces, only
  the alpha comes from the draw. Codes have no width (FUN_10128950 / FUN_10128ae0 hide them while wrapping), and each
  wrapped line starts with `1e <the last code>` (FUN_1012a4f0), so a colour carries over a wrap and a page break.
- The English grammar wraps names (FUN_100be680 / FUN_100be690), after their article: items (0x20..0x2a) `1e 02`,
  key items (0x30..0x36, 0x42..0x45) `1e 03`, Records of Eminence objectives (0x39 / 0x40 / 0x41) `1e 08`, each closed
  by `1e 01`. "Obtained: Potion." shows the name green.
- Continuation indent: FUN_10128ce0 wraps a log entry with wrapper mode 1 when the mode table row's flag byte (+3) is 1
  (FUN_10127870): chat 0x01..0x12, NPC talk 0x8e..0x91, 0x96, 0x98, 0xd2..0xd8, 0xdb..0xde. In mode 1 every line after
  the first, whether wrapped or after a 07 / 0d / 0a break (FUN_1025be40), starts with 81 40 (DAT_1036f120) and is
  narrower by its width. Battle and system modes (flag 2) do not indent.
- Event message pages (FUN_10126c60) only measure lines; a page after the first starts at its line with `20 20` (none
  for mode 0x97) and `1e <colour>`. The message's own mode is 0 (msg+4 from FUN_100c2e20) unless a 1f code sets it:
  mode 0 has no colour of its own (white) and no indent.
- Ours: dat/font.rs keeps `1e xx` / `1f xx` as one char (CODE_BASE U+100400) through decode / encode, glyphs() maps them
  to -0x100 - xx / -0x200 - xx, layout_line switches the colour (Font.codes from tables::code_colours); GameUi
  wrap_indent / wrap_spans carry the colour and indent; ChatLog keeps an indent bit per line (BattleText::indents); the
  event VM's messages take the Ctx of event::text_ctx (dates, roster, point names: they were missing there) and their
  mode, sounds and pages (cut_pages).
- Since done: `1e` from 0x11 (the colour-id table FUN_10129d00 with the config text colours, 0x80808080 when absent)
  and `1f xx` inside a line (mode xx's colour from there on, FUN_10129c70; not carried over a wrap): dat/font.rs
  `set_code_tables`, BattleText::code_tables, rebuilt when the text colour settings change. Not modelled: the log
  add's mode-2 flag (every line indented).
- Live (Lnxcsfix): "Obtained: Potion." with Potion in the code-2 green; the Home Point's line white as before.

From the research notes:
- The 1e palette 0x103353c8 (u32 x 17, no other reader): 00 / 01 / 09..10 = 0 (the line colour); 02 0x4040c000
  (green), 03 and 04 0x604040a0 (blue), 05 0xffa02080 (magenta), 06 0x60108080 (cyan), 07 0x60c09060 (pale yellow),
  08 0x80804020 (orange); alpha bytes are ignored.
- The expander copies `1f xx` through too and sets msg +4 = xx. FUN_10128ce0 stores each wrapped line in a 0x800-byte
  ring record: a 0x3c-byte header (byte 0 = the mode, u16 count @0x10, time @0x38), then u16 glyphs at +0x3c from
  FUN_101284f0: a char >= 0, `1e xx` -0x100 - xx, `1f xx` -0x200 - xx, `7f xx` -xx (2 bytes long for 31 / 32 / 33 / 37
  / fb / fc, 3 for 34 / 35 / 36, 4 for 38, else 1).
- Draws: the small log FUN_10162510 and the full log FUN_10138020 -> FUN_101622e0 -> FUN_101620f0 (the line colour
  FUN_10129c70(mode byte), recomputed every draw, so old lines follow a text colour change too, against "new lines
  only" in the config notes; worth a retail check) -> FUN_10162140. Gaiji (0x2115..0x2143) draw 0x80808080 whatever
  the colour; `7f` entries are skipped with no advance; a `CMP AX,0x200` at 0x101621e0 can never match (dead).
- Width: FUN_10128950 moves every `1e / 1f / 7f` code into a side list (8 bytes each) and leaves one 0x04 a byte;
  the wrap (FUN_1012a4f0 -> FUN_1025b6e0, fit FUN_1011d380, width FUN_1011cf70) treats 0x04 as zero width;
  FUN_10128ae0 puts the codes back. The wrapper state (+8 = 0x1e, +9 = the colour, 1 from FUN_1012a360 /
  FUN_1012a3b0, or the caller's pair via FUN_1012a420) is prepended to each line. On raw text an xx >= 0x20 would
  measure as a character.
- The same rules in rem4line / rem4li2 (FUN_10136670 builds, FUN_10136b40 draws), spoolmsg / splmsg2
  (FUN_10136fd0 / FUN_101370f0, up to 5 lines) and the event query window (vtable 0x10334dc0: title FUN_1014df50,
  rows FUN_1014df90, draw FUN_1014e220, the line colour mode 0x99's, id 0x5b).
- The colour-id table 0x1036e6e8 ({u8 id, 3 pad, u32}, ends at id 0, first match wins) is overwritten for ids
  0x54..0x6a / 0x6c / 0x6d / 0x6e / 0x70 / 0x71 by the config text colours (callback 0x1012a260, registered by
  FUN_101aa300 for configs 0x1b..0x31, 0x9b, 0xb0, 0xb3, 0xcb, 0xcc). Mode -> id: table 0x1036e888 ({u16 mode, u8
  id, u8 flag}).

## arealist modes 1 / 2: the event's area pick (op 0xcc 0x10 / 0x11) (2026-10-26)

- Op 0xcc 0x10 {val@2 tier, val@4 flat} (FUN_1020f1d0): mode 2 if val@4 else 1, the pick flag +0x6d set, +0x70 = tier;
  rows: no top rows, zones that pass the usual filter and are in the level table (DAT_1033b430) with tier <= the
  entry's, mode 2 only those with a max level; mode 1 follows the by-region view (Num+ flips it), mode 2 is flat;
  column 1 "Lv%2d~" (min) / "~Lv%2d" (max). No rows: nothing opens (the pick keeps its value *(inf)*).
- Enter on a zone: +0x6e = the zone, arealist and scsibori close, 0002, no search. Escape folds a region, else closes
  with +0x6e = -1 (set at open). The event start broadcast (0x800) closes arealist unless it is this picker.
- Op 0xcc 0x11 {set@2}: while +0x6d, wait; then FUN_100af310(2, +0x6e) and pc += 4.
- Ours: arealist::Mode::Event, open_event (World.arealist_req from the host, opened with the frame's GameUi),
  World.area_pick, Host::area_pick in the VM; the picker takes the keys ahead of the event.
- LSB uses it: the Feretory's Odyssean Passage (event 5, LSB monstrosity/passage.lua: "Stalk prey as a monipulator.").
  Live (Lnxcsfix by !zone 285): the picker by region (Ronfaure [2], Zulkheim [2], Gustaberg, Sarutabaruta), Ronfaure
  folded out to West / East Ronfaure "Lv 1~"; Escape twice gave -1 and the event went back to its menu, Quit ended it.
  Lnxcsfix's DB rows were restored afterwards (LSB makes her MON there).
- Seen there: the Feretory turns the player into a monster (MON job, the Monstrosity look); since 2026-10-26 drawn
  ("Monstrosity, part 1").

## faqmain and the comment editor: the mouse (2026-10-26)

- faqmain's handler (FUN_1021a240) takes no row clicks: its rows are drawn by code, not children. Its mouse messages
  are the bar's and the wheel's: 0x16 / 0x17 (the caps, the wheel) scroll 15 px, 0x18 / 0x19 (the track) 150 px,
  0x1b (the thumb) sets the offset (FUN_102180b0 / FUN_10218110); message 9 sets a hover flag (+0x4a); a right click is
  message 6. Ours: scrollbar Owner::Faq (faqmain::bar), the bar site while no field is open.
- The comment editor ("menu    comment", FUN_101dde60: messages 1..6, 8, 0xc, 0x11, 0x12) has no children and no bar:
  the mouse reaches it only as the right click, message 6 = Escape (commit, close, send when changed). Ours:
  seacom::right_click; the results window's pointer waits while the editor is open.

## The Linkshell Concierge (event 6100, s2c 0x048, link5 mode 1, lscswin) (2026-10-26)

- s2c 0x048 (0x100a0180), one form: per entry k (0..3) index @4+k: 0xfe clears the 16-slot table (FUN_10093b50, the
  entries before it in the packet too), a signed 0..15 fills slot b = {u16 @8+2k the row's item (its icon; 0 = no
  row), the 24 extdata bytes @0x10+0x18k, u32 attrs @0x70+4k}, anything else (LSB's 0xff) is skipped. LSB's "header"
  (FE FE FE FE) is only the clear. The zone load clears the table (FUN_10093720).
- Attrs: bits 1 / 2 / 5 language J / E / Other (FUN_101e3650: the lowest of bits 1..5), 6..9 members wanted, 14..15
  active tier, 16..31 characteristics.
- Op 0x71 sub 0x40 (FUN_100b8430): busy, the pick cleared, link5 opens in mode 1 (FUN_101e4470) with link6 mode 1
  (group 9 0x119 + val@2, "Linkshells Seeking Members", the Linkshell's icon) and lscswin; sub 0x41 waits while busy,
  then set@2 / @4 / @6 = slot index, GroupId, attrs (0 = cancelled).
- link5 mode 1: the header row (windowps 718 at the row's x - 3), then the slots with an item, by the filter; cells
  {0, 18, 280, 320, 350}: keytops3 0x219 and the item at half scale in the shell's colour, the name fitted (green for
  our linkshell 1's group), "J" / "E" / "?", the members wanted. Enter on the header SE 0002 only; on a shell: the pick,
  the windows close; Escape: cancel. Num+ (and the pointer over lscswin) hands the focus to lscswin (SE 0013): its ring
  of View All / Japanese / English / Other sets the filter 0 / 1 / 2 / 5 and gives the focus back.
- `7f 81 n`: slot num[n]'s shell name (its extdata Flag set).
- Ours: client/concierge.rs (World.concierge slots, concierge_ui, concierge_pick), the VM's op 0x71 0x40 / 0x41 with
  Host::concierge_pick, Ctx.concierge names; the list takes the keys ahead of the event; a right click is the focused
  window's Escape.
- Live (Lnxcsfix at the Bastok Mines concierge, seeded linkshell_concierge rows, removed after): the list with three
  shells and their tints, J / E / ?, the wanted counts; Num+ to lscswin, English filtered to one row; the pick printed
  "PenguinPals, correct?" and "Information for PenguinPals:" with LSB's language / wanted / active rows and the date;
  Back reopened the list (filter reset); hover moved the cursor and handed the focus to lscswin; Escape cancelled to the
  main menu.
- LSB issues to report (not ours to change): the posted date shows 9 hours early (LSB counts from 2002-01-01 00:00
  UTC, the client adds 0x3c307d70 = 2002-01-01 00:00 JST); shell names are letters only (LSB encodes a space as code 0,
  which shows as a backtick in retail too).

From the research notes:
- 0x048 handler registered at 0x10094571; slot = DAT_10488b08 + b x 0x20: +0 u16 item, +4..+0x1b the 24 extdata bytes
  (`u32 GroupId; u16 GroupKey; u16 Color (R, G, B, A nibbles, low first); u8 Flag; u8 Name[15]`), +0x1c attrs; +2..+3
  never written. FUN_10087cb0(n) = &slot n (n < 16), FUN_10087cd0(p) its index or -1, FUN_10087d10 copies the
  extdata. No size or state check; the list rebuilds its rows every frame. Attrs bit 0 (LSB "Active") is never read;
  bits 3 / 4 would show " ". No new c2s packet: every answer is c2s 0x05B.
- Event 6100 (zones 231 / 234 / 239, the same code; message ids below are zone 231's): start params (LSB
  `startEvent(6100, 0, gil, 0, 0, 0, caps, #rows, ls1GroupId)`): L0 the list title index, L1 gil, L5 = Z7 bit 0
  (debug: option 4 and a 4-number line), L8 = Z7 bit 1 (registration allowed: LSB after 45 days of character age), L6
  shell count, L7 our LS1 GroupId. Main menu 19291: 0 Nothing (end 0x40000000), 1 recruiting linkshells, 2 hand out
  linkpearls, 3 Tell me more, 4 the linkshell window (debug).
- Server ops (c2s 0x05B mode 1, option = op | payload << 8, each answered by 0x052): 0 (0x048 x 5); 5 / 6 the picked
  GroupId low / high 16 bits; 15 (0x05C: Z2 time zone 0..1 / days 2..9 / times 10..29, Z3 the posted date, Z9 1 =
  error); 7 receive a pearl (0x05C Z9 0 given, 1 refused + "one per day"); 10 (debug, ignored by LSB); 11 language
  8..9, members 10..13, active 14..15; 12 characteristics 8..23; 13 time zone 8..9, days 10..17; 14 times 8..27 (4 x
  5 bits: weekday start, stop, weekend start, stop; 0 none, 1..24 = 12 a.m. + h - 1). End option (Z1 bits 0..1): 1
  register, 2 pearl received, 3 delist.
- Show list: op 0; no shells -> 19301. `71 40` opens the list, `71 41 L30, L31, L33` = slot, GroupId, attrs; L31 0 =
  cancelled. 19321 "{7f81 num1}, correct?", ops 5 / 6 / 15; L43 language from attrs bits 1 / 2 / 5, L44 bits 6..9,
  L45 14..15, L42 16..31. Choice 19350 "Information for ...": rows 0..8 info, 9 characteristics (read-only choice
  19341 masked by L42), 10 the date, 11 Receive linkpearl / 12 Delist (L31 == L7: our own LS1 shell -> Delist shown,
  Receive hidden), 13 Back. Hand out pearls: 45 days (19316), LS1 must be a shell or sack (19308), 500 gil (6610),
  then plain choices for language, members (1..10), active members, days, times (x 4), time zone, characteristics,
  and a review (11 Post -> ops 11..14, Z1 = 1). All plain choices: no window.
- Op 0x71 (FUN_100b7e10): sub 0x40 (4 bytes) sets DAT_10489940 = 1 (busy) and clears DAT_10489934 / 38 / 3c, then
  link5 FUN_101e4470(1, LAB_100b8460, val@2) (ECX DAT_10663520); sub 0x41 (8 bytes) waits while busy. LAB_100b8460
  stores (index, GroupId, slot +0x1c) only when the slot's GroupId != 0 and always clears busy; the close hook's (0,
  0) call only clears busy.
- link5 mode 1 (DAT_10663520): FUN_101e4570 first closes link5, link6, link1..4 and link13; cursor windowps 75, 10
  visible rows of 0x12, inset (3, 3), cb at +0x6c, filter +0x78; then lscswin, the rows, link6 FUN_101e5b50(1, n), link5
  last. Registry: link5 0x30000 (0x10000 opens on child 1, the header), group 0; lscswin 0x80002, group 1. Layout
  (16, 106) 366 x 190, frame windowps 721, title 0xd 0x47, help 0xe 0x126, children 1..10 at (0, 5 + 18k) 356 x 16.
  Rows: header windowps 718 (358 x 16); the icon tint 0x80000000 | (R x 13 + 0x38) << 16 | (G x 13 + 0x38) << 8 | (B
  x 13 + 0x38) (FUN_101f4bb0 case 0x44); the name (FUN_101c8fb0, 20 chars) fitted to the column - 8 (FUN_101ca250),
  0x80509050 for our LS1's group (FUN_100e9730(.., 1)); the language letters FUN_101e36b0; row help 0xe 0. Enter
  FUN_101e48c0 -> FUN_101e4690; Escape -> FUN_101e4380 (cb(0, 0), lscswin closed); Num+ FUN_101e4440 (SE 0013 by
  FUN_10037e90); the pointer over lscswin (FUN_101e4610 with pointer mode 2, FUN_10118c10 *(inferred)*) sends Num+.
  Event 0x800 (FUN_101e43f0) closes link5 only in mode 0: the concierge list survives an event start.
- lscswin (DAT_10663554, vtable 0x10339530, ctor FUN_101e48f0): (384, 48) 112 x 93 anchored right, frame windowps
  714, help 0xe 0x374; children 88 x 16 at (16, 22 / 38 / 54 / 70): windowps 715 View All, 92 Japanese, 93 English,
  574 Other, a ring of links. Open FUN_101e4950 (cursor child 1); its draw FUN_101e4970 marks nothing, so the active
  filter is not shown; select FUN_101e49e0 (jump table 0x101e49cc); no sounds of its own; closed only with link5.
- link6 mode 1 (DAT_1066352c, draw FUN_101e5b20 -> FUN_101e5a80): (16, 48) 366 x 56, frames 3; text group 9 0x119 + n
  at (x + 0x40, y + 0x14), item 0x200's icon at (x + 10, y + 0xc). n = val@2 (LSB 0): 0x119 "Linkshells Seeking
  Members"; 0x11a..0x11e other titles (no use seen).
- `7f 81 n` (FUN_100c1650 asm 0x100c2164 -> FUN_100bda90 -> FUN_101cbac0(slot + 4)): the decoded name, no colour; a
  missing slot (n >= 16, Flag 0) makes the expander return 0 (asm 0x100c298c) *(inferred: the line never shows)*.
- Not traced: what a focus change between link5 and lscswin does beyond FUN_1015db80; whether anything closes the
  list when the server cancels the event (0x052 mode 2; link5 has no hook for it, LSB never does it).

## Item use in the Mog Garden; the status gate's bits 0x40 / 0x80 (2026-10-26)

- FUN_101cc0d0(mask, quiet): after 0x10 / 0x20 / 0x01 / 0x02 / 0x04, bit 0x40 is the costume (FUN_101cc040: the

  1); SubKind 6 models 0x7b8..0x7cb and 0x7d3..0x7da also set +0xf6 = 2. Ours parses both as an ordinary model id
  (dat/npc.rs, FUN_100c3180 type 0) *(not retail: the word's type bits pick another table; FUN_100c51c0 type 1 is id +
  0x996b, type 2 the furniture table thunk_FUN_101cce00: < 0x100 0x809f + id, < 0x200 0xc7ef + id, 0xe00.. 0xe75b +
  id)*. How FUN_100d0ef0 decodes the 0x9000 word is not traced (for LSB's only SubKind 6 NPC, Qiqirun 0x13fe, neither
  44393 = type 1 with the full id nor 40297 = type 1 with 12 bits is a model).
- Event op 0xb6 0x11 (FUN_100b1150 -> FUN_1008a750): only when the event actor's model is an XiModelActor (furniture
  class), FUN_100c4380(val@2) swaps its model to file FUN_100c51c0(2, val) (the furniture table). Not done (needs the

  +0x120 bit 5 is clear and +0x210 == 0, so a Monipulator keeps kind 2; every 0x00D (0x10099c29) and the zone-in reset
  +0xee under the same test. The 0x00D call (0x1009a0de) runs before the mask-0x04 part sets +0x210; 0x00E kind 1
  (0x1009c98a) passes from_npc = 1, which skips the marker test. LSB's costumes (m_Costume2) use the same marker; its
  0x00D form puts race << 8 | costume in t[0], read as a model id (an LSB quirk).

  0x0000 for many species (dhalmel, coeurl, opo-opo, manticore, gnole, crawler, spider, ...): model 0 is file 1300, an

  group 0x10; mp_cstm (130, 48) 182x210; mp_mncst (384, 48) 112x58 and mp_invnt (314, 48) 182x210, group 0x81 (with
  menuwind: the list suspends mp_mncst and the main menu); mp_mnnm, mp_mntp2, mp_kncst at (384, 48); level mode 2 at
  +0x34; bluehelp resized to level's rect. mp_stwin, mp_cost and mp_help have no registry row (dead layouts).
- Help (group 0xe) / titles (0xd): mp_mncst rows 0x2bd / 0x2be / 0x2bf, title 0xa5 "Customization" (mp_invnt, mp_cstm
  and mp_mnnm too); mp_mntp2 0x2c3, title 0x69 "Refine by Type"; mp_kncst rows 1..3 0x328, row 4 0x17b, title 0x69
  (sic); main menu row 2 0x2bc.
- 0x044 MON block (valid when @4 == 0x17): @8 species, @0xA rank (the cost cap tier), @0xC 12 x u16 instincts (item
  0x7400 + n), @0x24 / @0x25 descriptors. Cap FUN_100fda60 = level + 10 / 30 / 50 for rank 0 / 1 / 2 (any other:
  level); used = the 0x044 slots' costs (0 and 0xffff cost 0).
- Owned instinct n (FUN_100fdad0): n < 0x300 when the 2-bit count of species n / 3 (0x063 t3 @0x1c, dword[s >> 4] >>
  (s & 15) x 2) > n % 3; 0x300..0x35f the bought bit (t4 @0x88); else not. A species is owned when its level (t3 @0x5c
  / t4 @8) is non-zero; variants (>= 0x100) by the t4 @0x94 bit.
- Records: species 0xf000 + code: +8 the name ("Rabbit" for every variant), +0x2a the base species, the first string
  the help line ("Lapinion (Rabbit)"); instincts 0x7400 + n: +0x1c cost (0xff when the record is not in); catalogues
  0xeff8..0xeffe {u16 count, u16 0, count x {u16 item, u16 cost}} (cost 255 unused) give the list's order. Species
  types 1..19: DLL 0x10370280, 0x200 bytes just before the prefix table 0x10370480.
- Equip FUN_10141cc0: the same instinct on its slot -> 0xffff (remove); one already in any 0x044 or pending slot
  fails; then the effective set must cost <= the cap, else the pending slots are restored. Remove All: 0xffff where
  the 0x044 slot is set.
- mp_kncst while a field is edited: Down -1, Up +1, Right -10, Left +10 (sic); min 1.., max ..50; silent.
- LSB validates slots 3..799; retail lists bought instincts up to 0x35f (863): an n >= 800 fails the whole packet.
- Unclear: the list's +0x5c tag (5 / 9 / 7, never read); whether per-frame hooks run for a suspended window; the texts
  on the sprite labels; iteminfo's rows for instinct records (item type 0x1e); whether other servers fill 0x044 @0xA
  and @0x24 / @0x25.

  0x037 @0x59 for us (0x1009d90c). Only FUN_10150610 (the prompt arrow's tint) reads it here.

## Zone lines: the per-frame segment test (2026-10-27)

- User report: the Mog House entrance in Ru'Lude Gardens did nothing. The zone has one Mog House line, `zmrmzmrn`
  at (48.99, 17.19, -79.99), 12 x 10 x 10, under the floor of the lift beside the Elevator Button (LSB event 75,
  zone event 0x4b: "Enter the residential area?", then the player walks onto the lift and the script lowers its own
  body 0.05 a tick from y 10 to 15 while thread npc02b lowers the lift; fade `fdo2`, op 0x47 sends the spot, end).
  LSB ignores that 0x05C (onEventUpdate does not return 1: a mode 2 reply, the old place).
- FUN_1008b100 (from the per-frame actor pass, 0x10096969) runs every frame with our actor in (+0x120 bit 9), not
  zoning (DAT_10487e48) and no request pending (DAT_1048098e == 0); it does not look at events or input.
  FUN_10181510 -> FUN_10175910(actor +4, model +0x34): each 'z' / 'Z' rect with a second name dword (8-character
  names) maps both points into its unit box; a hit is either point inside or the segment crossing one of its faces
  (FUN_101768a0 over the 6 planes at 0x10376bc0). A hit: FUN_100a6070(0), DAT_10482f1e = 1 (the zone-line fade-out,
  60 ticks in FUN_1008abe0), DAT_1048098e = 1. FUN_1008abe0 sends 0x05E once the fade is done and the zone-in state
  (DAT_104807f0 byte 3) is 0, then DAT_1048098e = 2; FUN_1009ee60 mode 5 about us (a reset) clears it.
- So the event's draw override (the model) sinking into the box while the actor's own place stays at the button is
  what zones you in retail. Ours tested only our own place, and only while a move key was held.
- Ours: every frame (in the scene, not dead, nothing pending), Region::touches(our place, event::own_pose or our
  place); a hit during an event waits for its end (LSB blocks 0x05E in an event), then 0x05E as before. The 5 s
  resend and the 8 s give-up stay *(not retail: retail sends once and re-arms only on a mode 5 reset)*. Test
  dat::zone::tests::zone_line_segments. Live (Lnxcsfix, 2026-10-27): Elevator Button, Yes, the ride; at the event's
  end `zone line zmrmzmrn`, then the Jeuno Mog House (zone 243 at 0, 0, 0, music 126).

## Dual wield (2026-10-27)

- User report: Nine (Mithra NIN/THF, a Wakizashi in each hand: main and sub model 310) swung twice but the second blade
  was not in her hand. Engaged, we loaded the one-weapon battle files, whose motions leave the sub weapon's bones at the
  hip: the blade stuck out sideways behind her while the left hand swung empty.
- FUN_100cd3e0 (+0x8b5): a sub-slot model is a weapon (dual wield) unless its id (low 12 bits) is in a shield range
  [0, 0x3f], [0x75, 0x8f], [0x1d7, 0x1ff], [0x280, 0x2bf]. FUN_100cea10 case 7 then takes the sub file's info[3] (@0x33)
  as +0x88a and zeroes +0x87d (the upper-body file pick, skeleton + 1 + it); a shield keeps info[5] there.
- Engaging (state 0 -> 1 at 0x10089f46 in the old build): +0x8b5 picks FUN_100cf900 over FUN_100cf650. It loads the
  race base file FUN_100d0d00(race, 0, 0) (as the one-weapon loader), then FUN_100d0dc0(race, 1 / 2): table 0x103523a4
  + main info[3] and 0x1035236c + sub info[3], then FUN_100d0d00(race, 1, 1 / 2): skirts 0x103523b8 / 0x10352380
  [race * 2 + max(skirt - 1, 0)] + the same sets; a set of -1 skips its file. Tables (u16 x 9 / x 18, unchanged in
  30261006_0 at 0x1035d754..): dual main 40815 40815 42095 43375 44655 45935 45935 47215 48495, dual sub 40431 40431
  41711 42991 44271 45551 45551 46831 48111; skirts in dat/motionfile.rs. Mithra, set 3, skirt 2: 47218 / 46834 /
  47474 / 47090. The main file holds ati4 / ati5, atf0.., "in 0" / "out0", in10 / ot10; the sub file bti4 / bti5,
  btf0 btb0 btr0 btl0, in20 / ot20.
- The swing (FUN_100d4600 -> FUN_100d46f0): the hit's record (FUN_10185ea0: the action's records of 0x34, +8 the
  0x2c-byte result FUN_10185a20 parsed, its u16 @4 kind and @6 animation) picks the scheduler's first letter: kind 1
  with animation 1 (LSB LEFT_ATTACK, the off hand) 'b', 2 'c', 3 'd' (kicks), 4 the fixed "ls05" (a throw), then the
  'a' set. With +0x8b5 a 'b' scheduler calls the model's vtable +0x250(1) *(not traced: no effect seen; the after-image
  comes from the scheduler's own file)*.
- Ours: dat/motionfile.rs dual_wield / battle_files (PcMotion.dual = the sub's info[3]), dat/character.rs (the upper
  file pick zeroed), combat::swing_hand (start_attack gets the round's record). Test dual_wield_files. Live
  (Lnxcsfix NIN 30, two Wakizashi, a Wild Rabbit in West Ronfaure): battle files [47218, 46834, 47346, 46962], both
  blades in hand, records "kind 1 anim 0" then "kind 1 anim 1" played ati5 then bti4; out0 sheathed both at the hips.
- /equip (FUN_1007b390) looks an item up with FUN_101efff0(.., 1, 1) -> FUN_101f0060: the first flag skips items whose
  +8 (LockFlg: equipped, bazaar) is set, the second items an /equip took under 2 s ago (FUN_101efee0 marks, six slots,
  FUN_101eff30 checks; the clock DAT_10492e10+0xc counts whole seconds of timeGetTime), so `/equip main` then
  `/equip sub` on a pair takes both. FUN_1007b1c0 first: the slot already wears an item of that name: nothing. Ours
  matched the first by name, the one in the main hand, and refused 7 0x8e. Fixed (textcmd::find_free).

## Our upscale pack: every texture through Upscayl Standard 4x (2026-10-27; not retail)

texpack.rs (`tex-export`, `tex-pack`), the user's pick of model (upscayl-standard-4x) after a comparison page.
- tex-export: every stock IMG chunk (DatIndex::open_stock: no mods) once by an FNV key over size and pixels, as PNG,
  with manifest.tsv (file id, chunk, key, name): 131,017 chunks in 47,911 files, 33,363 unique images (762 Mpx);
  files with images named menu* / font* / cntg* / map* / ex3_* left out (pixel-cell UI, fonts, Primer pictures,
  maps), and images whose 4x passes 4096 a side.
- Upscayl CLI (/usr/share/upscayl/bin/upscayl-bin) leaks RAM per image (4.5 GB after 14k in one folder run):
  ~/ffxi/lab/scratch/upscale/tools/batch.py runs it per 1,500 hard links (it skips symlinks), ~150 s a batch.
- tex-pack: each manifest file rebuilt from the stock one with its images re-encoded (texpresso ClusterFit; DXT1 for
  a DXT1 original, else DXT3 with the alpha halved to the PS2 scale the client doubles), every encoding cached by key
  (files share images), ids sharing a file built once, built files kept (resumable). A chunk's size field is 19 bits
  of 16-byte units (8 MB): 26 images (4x of 512 x 1024 DXT3 and up) are halved until they fit (zone 100 broke before).
- Result: ~/.local/share/vana-client/mods/vana-upscale, 35,770 DATs, 29 GB, every file's chunk walk checked. The

## Dual wield: the draw and sheathe (scheduler op 0x84) (2026-10-27)

- User report: with a weapon in each hand neither the draw nor the sheathe played. The dual main file's "in 0" /
  "out0" (Mithra 47218) hold no motion: ops 0x07, 0x2f, 0x2e, 0x1f (wait 6), then two op 0x84 (waits 0x22, 0x20);
  "out0" calls "waot" (op 0x03) first.
- Op 0x84 (case at 0x10059ae3 in the old build, FUN_10057000): names "in10" / "ot10" / "in20" / "ot20" indexed by
  u16 @8 | u16 @10 * 2 (@8 sheathe, @10 the sub hand), the last byte replaced by '0' + the hand's digit: ECX = actor
  + 0x878, FUN_1005d300 +0x87c (main weapon info[4]) or FUN_1005d310 +0x87f (sub weapon info[4], set by FUN_100ceae0
  case 7 from the sub model's info @0x34); below 0 taken as 0. FUN_100cc440(.., 7, name, -1, 0, 0) then
  FUN_1004d400(0): a plain child scheduler on the actor's files.
- So "in 0" draws the main hand ("in1N": motion i0c?, sound sinr) at tick 6 and the sub ("in2N" in the sub file:
  i1c?) at 40; "out0" sheathes the sub ("ot2N": o0c?) first, then the main ("ot1N": o1c?). One-weapon "in N" / "out N"
  hold their motions themselves (no 0x84).
- Ours: PcMotion.sub_draw (sub info[4]), dat::motionfile::hand_name / hand_scheduler, dat::sched::hand_calls;
  actmotion::start merges each called hand scheduler's motions from its tick; the effects engine runs op 0x84 as a
  plain child on actor1, quiet as its parent (the hand schedulers' sounds; a child playing its own motion replaced the
  merged play, and the battle files left before the second hand's sheathe). Test dual_wield_files. Live (Lnxcsfix NIN
  30, two Wakizashi, a Wild Rabbit in West Ronfaure): engaged i0c then i1c, disengaged o0c then o1c.

## Held elements and their linked clones (Mihli's leftover puffs, 2026-10-27)

- User report: effects left behind in fights, first put on Shantotto II, then on Mihli Aliapoh's Protectra; retail
  shows nothing. Live repro (Lnxcsfix WHM 20 with Mihli, a Forest Hare in West Ronfaure): the leftover is file 4628
  (Mihli's job ability at the start of the fight, category 6 arg 0xf5, a second before her Protectra), folder
  `bsho`: pko1 / fro3 elements (flag 0x20000001, no draw, life 80) held at life 0 for good, each driving a linked
  clone (pkb2 / frm4, three teal puffs over her head) that never stopped emitting. Protectra (2927) itself ended clean.
- Retail FUN_10043ca0: life < 1 -> the end stream (FUN_1004d770); unless flag 0x20000000 the element is deleted; held
  ones get life 0 and are deleted once their linked clone (+0x164) has a reference count (+0x18 & 0x7fff) under 2.
  The element holds one reference (AddRef at 0x1004dee2 when emission op 0x44 / 0x53 / 0x6a makes it) and every live
  element holds one on its generator (released in FUN_10043b30), so the held element goes when the clone has no live
  elements. With no linked clone it stays held.
- Update ops 0x33 / 0x46 (FUN_100499d0, case 0x1004a654): the clone follows the element every frame, but runs
  (FUN_10048740) only while the element's life (+0x110) or the clone's own life (+0xd0) is not 0; op 0x25 needs the
  element's life. +0xd0 is the clone's life and +0xc8 its elapsed (FUN_10048740's t = 1 - (life - elapsed) / life).
- Ours (fx/mod.rs): Effects::expire deletes a held element whose clone is gone or has no live elements; drive() still
  moves a 0x33 / 0x46 clone with a held element but runs it only while either life is not 0. fx-shot of 4628 in zone
  100: before, 40+ `bsho` elements at 40 s; after, the puffs fade out by 4 s and nothing of 4628 is left.

## Buying from a player's bazaar: View Wares (2026-10-27)

Current build; packet layouts, the store and the 2019 cross-reference at the end of this entry.
- Enter on an enabled View Wares (SE 0002, c1 cleared) opens the shop list with the bazaar source (vtable
  0x10338ea4): the wares store is cleared and c2s 0x105 {UniqueNo, ActIndex, 0} goes out; LSB answers one s2c 0x105
  per priced item. The store (G+0x3aeb0, 81 records of 0x30 by the seller's slot) keeps item, index, count, unit price,
  24 extdata bytes and the tax rate; a record counts with an item, its own index, a count and a price (FUN_100e0300).
  The last tax rate with a count is kept apart (G+0x3bde6, survives clears).
- Rows every frame in slot order (no sorting, no end marker, no quantity column): icon, name, "N  G" darker
  (0x80606060) when we hold the item, "(+T  G)" in yellow with a zone tax (the window widens by its widest text + 0xf).
  Name tint: orange the row being bought, green worn equipment, yellow wearable, then grey when a unit with the tax is
  more than our gil. Tax per unit = max(1, price x rate / 10000) (FUN_100fd710 with n = 1; LSB charges
  floor(rate x price x n / 10000) + price x n; no zone of ours sets a tax).
- Enter on a row (FUN_101de4a0): refused (SE 0004) without a valid record, a known item, or the gil for a unit; no
  free-slot check. itemctrl up to min(count, gil / unit) (skipped at 1), then file 7031 line 0x5e "Purchase <n> <item>
  for <total> gil?" in the log and shopbuy with the cursor on Cancel. Buy sends c2s 0x106 {index u8 @4, qty u32 @8}
  only while the busy row still holds that record (a row before it may have sold out), else SE 0004. Nothing changes
  locally; 0x020 / 0x01D, the gil and the 0x105 for the slot do.
- s2c 0x106: State 0 group 9 0x28 "You made a purchase from %s's bazaar." (mode 0x79), else group 7 0x7c; both only
  with the system message filter (0x0B4 bits 11..12) under 2. s2c 0x107: store cleared, the list closed, View Wares
  disabled, group 9 0x29 under the filter. s2c 0x109 (another customer bought): file 7031 line 0x5d with the record's
  item unless the bazaar is ours (@0xe our ActIndex), the record's count lowered when @0xe is the bazaar we browse (LSB
  never fills it and sends the slot's 0x105 instead).
- Closing: Escape, the seller gone or beyond 50.0 (x / z), s2c 0x107, and everything that closes the inspect window
  (zoning, target dropped, engaged, an event); every close clears the store and sends c2s 0x104 (LSB refuses the next
  0x105 without it). The inspect window (and its comment window) is suspended while the list is up and takes the focus
  back after, View Wares disabled 2 s.
- Ours: bazaar.rs (Wares, on_item / on_buy / on_closed / on_sold), shop.rs View::Wares (open_wares, enter_wares,
  wares_line, send_wares_buy, leave_wares / close_wares, the reach in update), inspect.rs (View Wares, refocus, close),
  net.rs (s2c 0x105 / 0x106 / 0x107 / 0x109), modern/shop.rs ("Bazaar", no tabs, the tax cell). Test
  wares_records_and_tax. Not done: the per-id 1000 ms send refusal (FUN_100fc3c0). Not seen live: it needs a second
  player with a bazaar.

From the research notes:
- Packets (offsets with the 4-byte header). c2s 0x105 (FUN_100e0160, 0xc bytes): u32 UniqueNo @4 (inspect store
  G+0x19d20), u16 ActIndex @8 (G+0x19d1c), u16 0 @0xa; both kept at G+0x3bde0 / G+0x3bde4; the store is cleared even
  when the send is refused. c2s 0x104 (FUN_100e0110): header only, the store cleared first. c2s 0x106 (FUN_100e01d0):
  u8 index @4, u32 quantity @8.
- s2c 0x105: u32 price @4, u32 count @8, u16 tax rate @0xc (hundredths of a percent; LSB the zone tax x 100), u16 item
  @0xe, u8 the seller's slot @0x10, 24 extdata bytes @0x11. Record = G+0x3aeb0 + slot x 0x30 (no range check): +0
  item, +2 index, +4 count, +0xc price, +0x10 extdata, +0x2c tax rate. The kept tax G+0x3bde6 lies outside the cleared
  range (0x3aeb0..0x3bddf). LSB sends a sold-out slot with only its index (the row empties).
- s2c 0x106: u32 State @4 (LSB 0 OK, 1 ERR; 2 never sent), name[16] @8 (the seller). s2c 0x107: name[16] @4. s2c
  0x109: u32 buyer UniqueNo @4, u32 count @8, u16 ActIndex @0xc and u16 bazaar ActIndex @0xe (both 0 from LSB),
  name[16] @0x10, u8 slot @0x20; @0xe as the bazaar owner is inferred from its two comparisons; a count underflow
  keeps the record (as decompiled).
- Handlers: primary FUN_100e0040 (0x105 FUN_100e0370, 0x107 LAB_100e0400, 0x109 LAB_100e0430, 0x10A LAB_100e0500),
  secondary FUN_1020f530 (0x106 LAB_101dcc90, 0x107 LAB_101dcd10, 0x108 LAB_101dcd80).
- The per-id send refusal (not done): all four c2s go through FUN_100fc3c0(id, 0, 0); key 0 means a second packet of
  the same id within 1000 ms of the last is not built and silently dropped (table DAT_104dfd94 + 0x43e34, filled with
  1000). A 0x104 dropped this way leaves LSB's BazaarID set, and LSB refuses the next 0x105 until a later 0x104.
- The bazaar source DAT_10663488 (0xe4 bytes, FUN_101ddf90): +4 row count, +6 capacity 0x51, +8 rows (0x54 each, +0x48
  the record index), +0xc resized, +0xd tax column, +0xe the widest tax text, +0x10 busy, +0x11 busy record, +0x12
  busy row, +0x14 the seller's ActIndex. Vtable 0x10338ea4: +0 FUN_101ddfb0 free rows, +4 FUN_101de030 open (0x105),
  +8 FUN_100e0110 close (0x104), +0xc FUN_101de1a0 item info and reach, +0x10 FUN_101ddfe0 title 0xd 0x0e "Bazaar",
  +0x14 FUN_101de0c0 help (group 10 0x13 with tax / 100 when that is non-zero, else 0xe 0x2f), +0x18 FUN_1020f6c0
  width, +0x1c FUN_101de290 rows, +0x20 FUN_101de120 tint, +0x24 FUN_101de4a0 Enter, +0x28 FUN_101ddfd0 Escape. The
  purchase in progress: DAT_10663478 item, DAT_1066347a quantity, DAT_1066347c the unit price with tax.
- Columns (DAT_10385b7c): icon 0..0x12, name 0x12..0xb4, price 0xb4..0x102 (English; window 274); with a tax column of
  width w the window is 274 + w + 0xf and the tax cell ends at 0x102 + w + 0xf + 8 (FUN_10210880 asm
  0x1021095c..0x10210988). A record without an item record shows its icon and price, no name. Item info: the cursor
  row's item with its 24 extdata bytes (FUN_1013e200: augments, charges).
- Tax (FUN_100fd710) is worked in base-100 digits; a carry is dropped when it outlives the partial product (only rates
  with two non-zero base-100 digits, e.g. 150, can lose it). FUN_100fd820 = that + price x n. With a tax the total
  shown can be below LSB's charge. Reach: (dx^2 + dz^2) <= 2500.0 (_DAT_10338ed0).
- LSB (facts): c2s 0x105 is refused in an event and while BazaarID is set, needs the same Mog House id, and sends
  0x108 Enter to the seller; no bazaar packet has a distance check. c2s 0x106: BuyNum 1..99; ERR when buying from
  ourselves, no free slot, price 0, too few left, gil short, or a Rare item already held (0x009 ItemEx first); OK: the
  buyer gets a new slot (0x020 + 0x01D), 0x106 to the buyer, 0x10A + 0x020 + 0x01D to the seller, 0x109 and the slot's
  0x105 to every other customer, 0x107 to all when nothing priced is left. c2s 0x10B (the seller pricing) sends 0x107
  to every customer.
- 7031 0x5f "Bazaar closed due to {name}'s settings change." has no client caller *(inf: a server 0x053 line)*. Group
  9 0x29: "%s's bazaar was closed midway through your transaction.".
- Open / inferred: the flag FUN_10210880 passes to source +0xc, taken as "the list is live"; the windows hidden while
  the list is up come from the group walk (money 4 and iteminfo 8 take the comment window's bits 0x0c), not watched;
  the list's Escape sound (the generic close) not traced; "menu    shopbuy" has registry flags 0x00000002 (no 0x1000,
  unlike shopmain 0x00021002) while ours stacks the confirm on the log: to check against its layout position (16,
  256).
- 2019 build: the same logic with G = DAT_104cd388: registration FUN_100dd700 / FUN_10205d50 (0x106 LAB_101d5010,
  0x109 LAB_101d5080, 0x107 LAB_101d5090, 0x108 LAB_101d5100); the store FUN_100dda40 at G+0x350fc (the kept fields
  +0x3602c / +0x36030 / +0x36032); c2s 0x104 / 0x105 / 0x106 FUN_100dd7d0 / FUN_100dd820 / FUN_100dd890; vtable
  0x1032e2a4 (reach 0x1032e2d0); tax FUN_100fa7a0 / FUN_100fa8b0; rows 0x50 bytes, the item name at record +0xcc8.

## GPU uploads behind a slow link: host memory when it measures faster (ours, 2026-10-27)

- User report: 109-120 fps where 144 had held (cap 144, borderless on a 144 Hz VRR monitor; F12: cpu 5.6 ms, encode
  4.7 ms). The machine: RX 6800 XT in a Thunderbolt enclosure whose bridge trains at 8 GT/s x1 (05:01.0, capable of
  x4), with full ReBAR (heap 1, 16 GB, DEVICE_LOCAL | HOST_VISIBLE).
- perf with frame pointers (`dist` + force-frame-pointers): glibc's AVX-512 memcpy was 30% of the main thread, nearly
  all of it copying into wgpu staging buffers (egui-wgpu's update_buffers ~17% for ~185 KB a frame, EffectsGpu::update
  ~8%, upload_poses); CommandEncoder::finish's validation 15%. wgpu-hal maps every MAP_WRITE buffer to gpu-allocator's
  CpuToGpu, which prefers DEVICE_LOCAL | HOST_VISIBLE | HOST_COHERENT: VRAM through the BAR, every store across the
  link.
- vendor/gpu-allocator (0.28.0, [patch.crates-io]) measures it, as bg3le's memsteer does: at device creation CPU writes
  into the two types the allocator would pick are timed (4 MiB, best of 3 after a warm copy), and CpuToGpu goes to the
  first HOST_VISIBLE | HOST_COHERENT type without DEVICE_LOCAL only when the VRAM type writes under a quarter of host
  speed. Here: host 37-38 GB/s, VRAM 0.25 GB/s, steered; a desktop link stays as it was. FFXI_MEMSTEER=on / off
  skips the measurement. The client creates no MAP_WRITE buffers of its own, so only wgpu's staging moves.
- Measured windowed on Lnxcsfix in Qufim Island: cpu 2.5 -> 1.6 ms a frame, encode 1.8 -> 1.0 ms. Windowed FIFO stays
  at ~115-120 there (KWin composites at a fixed 144 Hz; uncapped Mailbox runs at 298 fps, so neither the GPU nor the
  CPU is the limit); under VRR the rate follows the frame time, so the CPU saved is fps.
- F12 and the FFXI_PERF line show "upload N KB/frame": every Queue::write_buffer goes through render::Put (counted in
  render::WRITTEN) plus egui's vertices and indices. About 230 KB a frame in that scene.
- Not the 4x pack: zone 126 renders offscreen in 0.89 ms a frame at 1600 x 900 with and without vana-upscale.

## Effect task slots: copies reuse free slots (the slowdown over time, 2026-10-27)

- User report: 144 fps held, then sank under 100 after a while in Qufim Island; zoning restored it. The census added
  to the log (once a minute, client/mod.rs: live / allocated tasks, generators, elements, the most numerous by name;
  also on F12) on Lnxcsfix running laps of Qufim and fighting (immortal): live tasks stayed 1..10 while the task list
  grew 1 -> 243 -> 437 -> 1441 -> 2327 -> 3966 -> 5678 in nine minutes, the frame's CPU time 1.4 -> 4.8 ms and the rate
  740 -> 198 fps. Zoning clears the list (load_zone), hence the recovery.
- Cause: two ops pushed their task copies on the list instead of taking a free slot: op 0x52 (the Vana'diel time
  window's copy) and ops 0x64 / 0x65 (the conditional block's clone). Every frame walks the whole list (step_tasks,
  posed_actors, the live uids) and every new task scans it for a free slot.
- Fix: Effects::later_slot: the copy takes a free slot past the running task's (the frame's step still reaches it, so
  it runs this frame as a pushed one did), else a new one.
- Also on F12 now: GPU time per frame stage (render/gputime.rs: timestamps between the passes, TIMESTAMP_QUERY and
  TIMESTAMP_QUERY_INSIDE_ENCODERS when the device has them; each line with FFXI_PERF) and the effect counts.

## Scenery culled on the GPU (ours, 2026-10-27)

- Before: every zone draw (one per MMB model, all of its mesh's placements instanced) went in every frame, wherever the
  camera looked; placements outside their LOD band were collapsed in vs_main after their vertices ran. Retail culls on
  the CPU with the MZB's tree (FUN_1017c8b0; the tree below).
- render/cull.rs, zone.wgsl cs_cull_vis / cs_cull_compact: per instance its mesh's box (model space, over every model
  drawn) and the draws' runs (a mesh's normal, mirrored or both placements: instance range, where the visible copies
  go, the draws' indirect argument slots). Each frame, from the uniforms render() writes: pass 1 marks each instance
  (the LOD band as vs_main tests it to the origin, then the box through the model, door part and voyage matrices
  against the six frustum planes, clip z 0..w); pass 2, a workgroup a run, copies the visible instances in order
  (an inclusive scan of 64 flags at a time) into a second instance buffer and writes the run's draws'
  DrawIndexedIndirect arguments. The zone's draws then go in as draw_indexed_indirect from that buffer.
- Empty indirect draws cost the GPU about as much as full ones (its command processor fetches each draw's arguments),
  so the CPU also leaves out the runs that cannot show: each run's world box over its placements' geometry and the
  box over their origins with the union of their bands, built at load; a run goes in when its box (2 % + 0.5 larger)
  meets the frustum and its origins can be within its bands. Runs with door parts or a voyage's world always go in.
- Needs INDIRECT_FIRST_INSTANCE (requested when the adapter has it); without it, or with FFXI_NO_CULL, the draws go
  in as before. A sub-area's scenery is culled the same way with its own buffers (2026-10-28; San d'Oria's 335
  pixel-identical to unculled, inside and out). Mog House furniture draws as before: a few dozen pieces that layout
  mode moves, whose run boxes would go stale.
- Checked: six views in zones 126, 230 and 102 pixel-identical to the unculled render; the GPU time of render()
  (FFXI_BENCH=N on the offscreen tools, now timed by GPU timestamps too) 0.83 -> 0.32 ms looking along the ground in
  Qufim Island, 1.51 -> 0.81 ms in a Southern San d'Oria street, 0.80 -> 0.49 ms in La Theine, unchanged top-down
  (everything in view).

From the research notes:
- Names: scene S = DAT_10631f24 (this of FUN_1017b510), env E = DAT_1065cb04 (0x1dc bytes, ctor FUN_1018b170), camera
  C = DAT_104568fc. An instance (a placement at run time) is 0x16c bytes, an array per scene slot at slot +0x28 (slots
  at S+0x60 + 0x78 k, k = 0, 1).
- FUN_1017b510 each frame: view V -> S+0x38d9c, render projection C+0x154 -> S+0x38ddc; D (FUN_1018b8f0(E, 0)) ->
  S+0x39420, D^2 -> S+0x39424, K (FUN_101892b0(E, 0)) -> S+0x39428; cull projection Pc = FUN_10182490(S+0x38e5c, w, h,
  focal, 0.2, D), M = V x Pc -> S+0x38fdc (a voyage slot: (Vvoy x V) x Pc -> S+0x38edc, Vvoy = S+0x38e1c); the eye
  C+0x50 -> +0x44 -> S+0x390f0. Then per slot: the candidates (a camera list, else the tree, else every instance),
  each tested and drawn, the slot's deferred list, then the door groups (FUN_1017ade0 -> FUN_10183da0).
- MZB header (FUN_10179430; offsets from the MZB start): 0x03 version (0x1b in every current zone), 0x04 record count
  (low 24 bits), 0x08 collision table, 0x10 tree root (version >= 0x15; 0 = no tree; below 0x15 the camera-list
  count), 0x14 camera-list pool (below 0x15 the first list), 0x18 light list (version > 0x11). File order in 230:
  header, records (0x64 each), the list pool at 0x20 + 0x64 x count, tree nodes, leaf index lists, lights, collision.
- Tree node, 0x80 bytes (walk FUN_1017c8b0, relocation FUN_1017c820): +0x00..+0x5f 8 world corners (f32 x, y, z;
  axis-aligned boxes in practice); +0x60 the offset of u32 idx[count] (0-based record indices; nonzero = a leaf, its
  children ignored); +0x64 count; +0x68..+0x77 4 child offsets (0 none, filled from the first); +0x78..+0x7f zero. On
  230, 193 and 102 every leaf is at depth 6 and every placement in exactly one leaf; an interior box is the union of
  its children's, a leaf's the union of its placements' world boxes from the record's named MMB (not the _h sibling)
  *(inferred: a quadtree over x / z built offline)*. 230: 990 nodes / 549 leaves; 102: 2331 / 1547; 193: 545 / 199.
- The walk starts at the root's 4 children (the root box is never tested); a culled node skips its subtree; no
  distance test on nodes and no fully-inside shortcut. A leaf's instances with state > 1 go to FUN_1017c9c0 (render
  mode S+0x3949c == 2: FUN_1017de20, the same tests) or to the deferred list. Child boxes lie inside their parents'
  and the test is per plane, so the tree drops only what the per-instance tests drop: the GPU pass stands in for it.
- Records carry no bounds: the instance box (inst +0xf4..+0x153, 8 world corners) is built at load (FUN_1017a710) from
  the high LOD model's (inst +0x18) MMB box (payload +0x24..+0x3b: x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1) through the instance matrix
  (inst +0x40). No model: no box, nothing drawn. Ours boxes each LOD mesh itself (a tiny difference).
- Record fields culling reads: +0x10 translate -> inst +0x1c (the distance origin); +0x34 group id -> +0xc0 (nonzero:
  state 0, not drawn by this pass; '_' / '@' groups go as door groups); +0x38 / +0x3c -> +0xc8 = r38^2, +0xcc =
  max(r38, r3c)^2 (the LOD bands); +0x40 -> +0xd0 = r40^2 (the own distance, used when +0x46 bit 0 -> inst +0xb);
  +0x46 bit 2 -> inst +0xf (drawn deferred, after the slot's other placements: list S+0x37540, 12-byte entries, at
  most 0x200, extras dropped; its counter S+0x38d40 is zeroed once a frame, not per slot, so slot 1 redraws slot 0's
  deferred entries, as read; one record in Whitegate has the bit; not modelled); +0x50 == the loaded sub-area S+0x17c
  -> state 1 (hidden). State inst +8 (FUN_1017a630): only state > 1 draws.
- Frustum test FUN_10181bb0(M, 8 points): clip = (p, 1) x M, a = |w|; outcode bits 1 x > a, 2 x < -a, 4 y > a, 8 y <
  -a, 0x10 z > a, 0x20 z < -a; culled when the AND of the 8 outcodes is nonzero (corners behind the eye always set
  0x20). Our box-against-planes test gives the same answer for boxes in front.
- Cull projection FUN_10182490(out, w, h, s, n, f): Pc = diag(1, 1, -1, 1) x
  [[2s/w,0,0,0],[0,2s/h,0,0],[0,0,(n+f)/(f-n),1],[0,0,-2nf/(f-n),0]] (the scene is right-handed). n = 0.2 (render near
  0.1); f = D; s = focal C+0x2f4 (350, zoom 242..900); w = 512 / C+0x2f0 (C+0x2f0 = h / (0.75 w) of the aspect entry:
  1.0 at 4:3, 0.75 at 16:9); h = u16 C+0x1a, set once at scene init (FUN_10178f90), the 3D target height (default 512)
  *(inferred: the background resolution's Y)*. It holds the render frustum whenever h >= 384, so it removes nothing on
  screen but by its near (0.2) and far (D) planes.

## Two-factor sign-in (ours, 2026-10-27)

- User's request: a button on the login screen that enrols TOTP. LSB's auth service (src/login/auth_session.cpp,
  otp_helpers.h) checks the password on each command: 0x31 CreateTotp -> result 0x10 with `TOTP_uri`
  (otpauth://totp/SERVER:USER?secret=...&issuer=SERVER&algorithm=SHA1&digits=6&period=30; a new secret, not validated,
  replaces an unvalidated one; refused while a validated one exists); 0x34 VerifyTotp (otp) -> 0x11 with the
  `recovery_code`, the secret validated (from then on Login needs the otp); 0x32 RemoveTotp (otp or the recovery code,
  case-insensitive) -> 0x12, the trust tokens dropped; 0x33 RegenerateRecovery (otp or recovery code) -> 0x11 with the
  new code. Every refusal is the error text "Failed to validate credentials".
- Ours (client/twofa.rs): the login form's Two-factor button (focus 8, under the labels on the box's row; needs the
  server, account and password). Its window over the form: Turn on (the URI as a QR code, error correction M, from the
  qrcode crate, and the key in groups of 4; a code field; Confirm -> VerifyTotp; then the recovery code to keep), Turn
  off and New recovery code (a code or the recovery code), Close. Errors show in the window in yellow; the help line is
  the window's. Classic: the game font and buttons over an opaque backing; modern: Modern::twofa_window on the same
  rects. Offscreen: topbar-shot --config login2fa[:scan|:code|:done].
- Login: LSB answers a missing or wrong otp with LOGIN_ERROR 0x02, the same as a wrong password (auth_session.cpp), so
  0x02 reads "invalid username, password or one-time code".
- Seen live 2026-10-28 on a throwaway account: Turn on (the QR decodes to the server's otpauth URI), Confirm with the
  app's code (validated on the server, the recovery code shown), a login without the code refused, with it to the
  character list, New recovery code with the app's code (the server's code replaced by the one shown), Turn off with
  the recovery code in lower case (the row gone). The modern window is drawn opaque
  whatever the Opacity setting, so the form under it does not show through.

## Draw distance: retail's, and the Draw Distance setting (2026-10-28)

- Retail (FUN_1017c9c0, FUN_101892b0, FUN_1018b8f0, FUN_10189120; more below):
  - D = max(K x env@0x58, 43) (map 0xc1: @0x58 itself; 100 before an env is up).
  - K = X, halved when @0x58 > 500 and the Clipping flag F is 0.5 (map 0x32: K >= 0.7).
  - X = (config 0x3e + 25) x 0.02, F = 0.5 below X 0.99. At the default Clipping (25), K = 1 and D = @0x58
    (302 in Qufim Island, La Theine and San d'Oria).
  - A placement draws when its origin is within D, or within its own distance (record +0x40, used when +0x46 bit 0)
    times sqrt K. A door group's must be within both.
  - The cull frustum's far plane is at view depth D. Fog start and end are scaled by K.
  - Emitters without their own range (op 0x0a) show within D. Actors whose skeleton box's farthest corner is deeper
    than D are neither drawn nor targetable.
  - Data (La Theine): grass `_kusa_*` 50, trees 80..170, hit walls 1; the mountains (`pl_moa*`) carry 1000 without
    the flag, so retail drops them past 302.
- Ours: dat/zone.rs Placement::own_dist; dat/weather.rs clipping(), Lighting::draw_dist and the fog x K.
  - render/cull.rs: each instance's rule rides in its bounds' fourth words; area_info.zw = D, K.
  - render/zone.wgsl cs_cull_vis: the distance test before the LOD band, and the depth plane.
  - RunBox::maybe_visible: skips runs whose nearest origin is past their largest reach.
  - client: the actors' far_out set; the effects' Frame::draw_distance.
- Settings > Screen > Draw Distance (not retail; config `draw_distance`, percent of retail's, 0 = no limit):
  - Retail, 1.5x, 2x, 3x, Unlimited; default Unlimited, the look before this change.
  - Retail's limit is a 2002-hardware one (CLAUDE.md: such limits become settings).
  - A scale s multiplies D by s and K by s squared (the own distances by s). The fog stays retail's.
- Checked offscreen (zone-shot applies the Retail distance; FFXI_NO_CLIP turns it off):
  - La Theine from above: GPU 0.876 -> 0.061 ms; the far mountains gone past 302.
  - La Theine along the ground: 0.430 -> 0.348 ms; grass within 50, trees within their distances.
  - Qufim: about 1000 pixels differ; San d'Oria: none.
  - Live in Qufim at Retail: scenery, actors and plates draw.

From the research notes:
- Per placement (FUN_1017c9c0), in order: the origin inst +0x1c (a voyage's through Vvoy), d^2 = |origin - eye|^2;
  inst +0xb clear: drawn when d^2 <= D^2, set: when d^2 <= K x inst +0xd0 (K not squared, so the own distance scales
  by sqrt K; `<=` at asm 0x1017cab4); the frustum (FUN_10181bb0 with M or Mv on inst +0xf4); the LOD: d^2 > +0xcc low
  (+0x10), > +0xc8 medium (+0x14), else high (+0x18), a null model skipped; then only state setup (no per-piece
  bounds, no alpha or fog skip). S+0x39448 counts the drawn placements.
- Door groups (FUN_10183da0): origin distance against min(D^2, K x inst +0xd0) when inst +0xb, else D^2; the frustum
  with M; always the high model. Other users of D: effects without their own range (FUN_100496f0 at 0x10049851) and
  door actor visibility (FUN_100ac5a0 at 0x100ac649).
- D's source: the 0x2f environment's f32 @0x58, lerped between hour keys like every field (FUN_10189980); E+0x18 the
  work struct, E+0x1c = work + 0x4c (FUN_101880c0), read by FUN_10187020 (E+0x1c -> +0xc = work @0x58). Units: yalms.
  The FUN_101848d0 of the zone weather entry is an old-build address.
- K = FUN_101892b0(E, p) (p 0 scenery and fog, 1 actors): 1.0 while the env allocation is not live (heap header E-0x1c
  != 1); else r = 1.0, halved when an env is loaded, @0x58 > 500 and F != 1.0, then r x= X; E+0x1d4 > 0 -> max(r,
  E+0x1d4), < 0 -> min(r, -E+0x1d4). D = FUN_1018b8f0(E, p): raw = @0x58 (100 without an env); E+0x1d0 > 0 -> max(K x
  raw, E+0x1d0), else raw (K ignored). E+0x1d0 = 43 and E+0x1d4 = 0 at construction; map 0xc1 sets E+0x1d0 = 0, map
  0x32 E+0x1d4 = 0.7 (FUN_1018b3a0).
- Config 0x3e (apply 0x101aa650 case 0x3e): X -> DAT_10456ab8 and DAT_10456aa8 (scenery and actors, always equal), F
  -> DAT_10456a5c / DAT_10456a6c.
- D is not in the render projection (near 0.1, far C+0x2e0 = 65535, FUN_10015490). Fog (FUN_10189120): FOGEND = fog
  end x K, FOGSTART = fog start x K (start + 1 when end <= start); fog end can pass D (230: up to 450 against 302).
- @0x58 by zone (current DATs): 193 120; 26 130; 149, 191 203; 100, 104 252.5; 102, 115, 126, 230, 231, 241 302; 288
  361; 50 600; 245 1000 (500 on one key). Mostly constant per zone; a few weather keys differ.

## Camera lists (retail's visible sets) in the GPU culling (2026-10-28)

- Retail:
  - MZB +0x14 (version >= 0x15): u32 n, then n lists of { u32 count; u32 placement[count] }.
  - Each collision object's +0xa8 is the MZB offset of one list (0 none). Checked on 230, 100, 193 and 231: every
    nonzero +0xa8 lands on a list start. No file cell list carries flag 0x800 or 0x2000, and none is chained.
  - FUN_10179390 (before the draw) takes coll+0x1807c, set by FUN_101813f0's probe from the camera eye.
    - The first segment runs 0.51 above the eye to 100 below it. If nothing is hit, a second runs 0.51 below the eye
      to 15 above it.
    - FUN_1016a2d0 walks the cells within 1 of the start's. It checks each object's y range against the segment's,
      and skips objects whose +0xbc is the loaded sub-area.
    - The list is the nearest hit's +0xa8, among hits from cell lists without 0x800 (0x800 hits only set the
      surface).
  - FUN_1017b510: while a list is in force, slot 0 draws only its placements, each still distance / frustum / LOD
    tested. Door groups are drawn apart, and the sub-area slot gets no list.
  - Interiors (335, 326) carry no lists. Zones without lists (La Theine, Bastok Markets at the views tried) draw as
    before.
- Ours:
  - zone::camera_lists (ZoneScene::camera_lists, the last MZB's, as collision) and collision::Object::vis. A merged
    sub-area's objects get vis 0 *(inf: retail would hand slot 0 a list from the sub-area's pool; no interior has
    one)*.
  - Ground::camera_list(eye): the same vertical segments as covered(). *(inf: our door boxes name no list)*
  - ZoneRenderer::set_camera_list: a per-instance mask from each instance's record (door parts always pass).
  - Cull::set_mask, a storage buffer: word 0 is the flag, then a bit per instance; cs_cull_vis tests it first. The
    CPU skips runs with no listed instance.
- Only at Settings' Draw Distance = Retail: the lists leave out what peeks over walls, as retail does; at the
  larger distances they would cut the scenery that setting is for.
- Checked offscreen at Retail (zone-shot applies the list under its eye; FFXI_NO_LISTS to compare):
  - Southern San d'Oria gate: GPU 0.96 -> 0.23 ms, 7442 pixels differ (the battlements beyond the inner wall).
  - Street: 0.71 -> 0.41 ms, 1146 pixels (rooftops over the wall). Square: 0.83 -> 0.49 ms, identical.
  - Windurst Waters: 0.31 -> 0.27 ms, 1349 pixels.

From the research notes:
- Below MZB version 0x15 the header's 0x10 is the list count and 0x14 the first list (no pool count). FUN_1017af30
  turns list indices into instance pointers; FUN_10167f50 relocates each collision object's +0xa8. The object count
  equals the record count in every zone checked.
- The probe runs every frame before the draw (FUN_101813f0, then FUN_10179390, from the game update at 0x10013cbb /
  0x100144d9); constants 0x10336788 = 0.51, 0x1033678c = 15. FUN_1016a2d0 resets coll+0x1807c first, skips cell lists
  with head flag 0x2000, and needs the object's y range (+0xb4 / +0xb8) and sub-area (+0xbc) checks. The result goes
  coll+0x1807c -> S+0x3912c; a slot uses it only when it has lists (slot +0x34), with no tree walk, and the list is
  cleared for the second slot.
- Data: 230 44 lists (179 of 1675 placements on average; 666 objects name one); 100 65 (1010 of 8177); 193 32 (24 of
  220); none in 102, 26, 256. A list can leave out placements that are in the frustum and in range *(inferred: an
  offline visible set per floor region)*.

## GM prompts: "menu    gmtell" (2026-10-28)

- s2c 0x017 Kind 0x0c (LAB_100e37a0: byte table 0x100e3de8 -> jump table 0x100e3da0 entry 8, 0x100e3cb7; any sender
  past the block list, GM flag or not) draws no line: FUN_100a40a0 queues the sender (24 bytes) and the text (0x100;
  the packet's text is cut at 150 as every 0x017) in 4 slots of 0x140 at DAT_10485a78. In an event (DAT_10487e48, set
  at an event's start, cleared at the zone load) it answers group 9 0x82 at once; with every slot taken 0x83.
- FUN_100a3d00 (each frame, FUN_10096640 after the K.O. machine): in an event any flagged slot is cancelled with 0x84
  and the window closes; else with no window the lowest flagged slot opens (FUN_100a3f10), else the window's result
  (+0x548, FUN_1014e1c0) is polled: 0xff / negative 0x85, an answer id 0x86. The zone load clears the slots
  (FUN_10093720 -> FUN_100a3cd0).
- FUN_100a3f10: the text split by FUN_100a3fe0 (a word is a quoted run to its closing quote, else up to a space or
  tab; the blanks after it skipped): the first word the question (FUN_1014df50), up to 8 more the answers
  (FUN_1014df90, ids 1..8). No question or no answer: the slot goes with no tell.
- The answers (FUN_100e3570: c2s 0x0B6 to the sender, Kind 3, no log echo; a first lower-case letter capitalised in
  some languages): 0x82 "Currently in an event. This GMTELL was invalidated.", 0x83 "Currently four GMTELL's have
  been received. ...", 0x84 / 0x85 "GMTELL(%s): Question(%s): Result (Canceled due to event activation.)" /
  "(Canceled.)", 0x86 "GMTELL(%s): Question(%s): Result (%s)"; the first %s is the player's shown name
  (FUN_100a3ea0: actor +0x210 ? +0x214 : +0x7c).
- The window: the query's class (FUN_1014dd30, 0x54c; vtable 0x103352c8 vs the query's 0x10335280), the same layout
  (16, 208, 366x88, rows 1..3), registry flags 0x11012 (stacked on the log). Only the key handler differs
  (FUN_1014e550): Down / Up one answer without wrap or pages, the view inside 3 rows, SE 0001 when it moved; Enter the
  cursor's answer; Escape always cancels (0xff, SE 0003). No wheel, bar or row messages.
- LSB (luautils SetCustomMenuContext / HandleCustomMenu) sends `"title""opt1"...` from "_CUSTOM_MENU" (!menu, !quest,
  !mission, !afkcheck, !minigame) and reads the answer from the tell's "Result (" text. Seen live 2026-10-28 (Lnxcsfix,
  both UIs: a pick and a cancel).
- Ours (client/gmtell.rs): an event answers every waiting prompt once with 0x84 (retail repeats the open slot's tell
  each frame while another slot waits, the window already gone); the mouse moves the cursor and a click picks, as in
  the query *(inf: retail's handler takes no row messages)*. The modern UI shows it as a "gm prompt" panel.

## Event timers: "menu    eventtim", the event cast bar, the timed choice (2026-10-28)

- Op 0xb4 (FUN_100b0a00) 7 / 0xa: unless "menu    casttime" / "menu    eventtim" is open, FUN_1012c1d0(4, val@2) /
  FUN_1012c500(0, val@2) open it for val@2 ticks (negative 0); 8 / 0xb close it (FUN_1015e910); 9 / 0xc write
  ftol(remaining ticks, +0x18) to set@2, 0 when it is not open. Supersedes "ours 0" in "Op 0xb4" above.

  frame's whole ticks (FUN_10014d60). Drawn (FUN_1012c280, mode 0): FUN_101c93c0(ftol(remaining / 60)) ("%d:%02d",

  (World::ext_job_sent).

  right-aligned and "%d" left-aligned at that x. Records not yet loaded are skipped that frame.

  lines at (x0 + 16, y0 + 20 + 16k); no footer.

  0x80909040. Fits: free[e] = capacity - used, plus the nibbles of the attachment under automato's cursor while a slot
  is picked; every non-zero cost <= free (signed bytes). pupsibor rows keytops3 420..427; Up / Down wrap; Enter on child
  k sets filter k + 1 and closes it; Escape leaves the filter at 0.
- Activated check FUN_101cc400 (only at a flow's first step): our pet (actor +0x1fa) exists and its name (+0x7c, or
  +0x214 when +0x210 != 0) equals the block's name -> group 7 0xb8, SE 0004. Remove All and Element do not check it.
- Keys: flow B's Enter on a slot plays SE 0002 (or 0004) and then SE 0002 again; Escape on automato with only a slot
  picked, or on the list with only an item picked, does nothing; Num+ with a pick: automato SE 0004, the list nothing.
  Mouse (inferred, as BLU and the Equipment grid): hover moves the cursor, a click on it is Enter, the pointer over the
  other window swaps the focus when nothing is picked.
- c2s 0x102 examples: head Valoredge @4 02, @0xc 02; frame Sharpshot @4 22, @0xd 22; Strobe in slot 2 @4 01, @0xe 01;
  removing Scope (0x42) from slot 5 @4 00, @0x11 42. Remove All copies block bytes +6..+0x13 and is sent even when
  everything is empty. Heads and frames are never removed.
- LSB: no reply while an automaton is out; a head / frame change does not re-check attachments (used can exceed
  capacity: red counts); an attachment already in another slot is refused (retail may move it); no message on a refusal.
- Open: whether flow B's double SE 0002 is heard twice and whether automato's per-frame message 8 under the pointer
  repeats SE 0004 while an item is picked; how unfocused automato draws its cursor while a slot is picked; pupsibor's
  starting cursor (FUN_10118870's memory or child 1).

## Log window 2 (2026-10-28)

Retail (FUN_10161b80 class, FUN_10161c70 placement, routing FUN_10127c00 ->
FUN_10128ce0 -> FUN_10129980, region 0 FUN_1015f980). Ours: client/logwin.rs (`LogWin::second`, `Route`, `mode_bit`,
`second_rect`, `caption_1`), the world's `log2`.
- Config 0xb4: 0 off, 1 above window 1 (same x, bottom on window 1's top), 2 right of it (left edge on window 1's
  right, bottoms aligned; unclamped, so at 100 % widths it runs off-screen as retail's). Its own 0xb6 fixed, 0xb7 max,
  0xb8 min, 0xc5 width, 0xc6 seconds (the -1s follow window 1 once, cfgapply::normalise); every setter fills it.
- Routing at print time: window 1 takes everything while window 2 is off, GM lines (s2c 0x017 Attr bit 0), and the
  modes its mask {0xb9, 0xba} allows or that have no bit; window 2 never GM lines, only modes its mask {0xbb, 0xbc}
  allows. Mode -> bit: table 0x1036e888 -> FUN_1012a120 (MODLOG "The full log's tabs and the log filters"). Defaults: chat, emotes, NPC talk
  to window 2; battle, system and modeless lines to window 1. A route change (0xb4, the masks) or a reopen rebuilds a
  window from the log newest first through its mask until more than 49 rows (FUN_101295d0).
- Window 2 runs window 1's rule with its own values, held at its max by window 1's Num+ focus, never moved for the
  chat line, shrunk by the same Escape; captions 740 "Window 2" and, with it on, window 1's "Window 1:Say" (733..739;
  Yell keeps 278). Window 1 draws after it (later in the window list). Region 0 (flag 0x1000 windows, the compass,
  the party icons, the Timers window) is window 2 while it is up above window 1, else window 1; faded, they sit on
  its bottom (GameUi::log_bottom).
- Lines now carry their print mode: event text its mode (pages 0x98, the queues' writer FUN_10136670), battle
  messages BATTLE + their relation mode (the modern Battle tab tests combat::is_battle), chat lines their GM flag.
- Window 1 fixes: 0x9c fills it like the other setters; seconds per line under 3 are 3 (FUN_10162ea0);

## Mog House gardening (2026-10-28)

Ours: client/garden.rs (replacing layout mode's stand-in /garden).
- /garden (its gate in textcmd.rs, plus ours: not while gardening) opens bankmenu for the Safe (myroom mode 2);
  Escape ends it. A Safe with no installed pot: moogle 0x3b. Else mode 3: furnished rooms (myroom::has_floors) hide
  the player at the room's middle with focal 350 and frame the pot under the list's cursor (FUN_101d4500: look 0.4
  above it, eye 1.5 from it toward the room's axis, eased 0.3 a retail frame); context 0x42 holds the player.
- The pot list (inventor with the pot source): installed flowerpots of that Safe in slot order; every open says
  0x3d (furnished 1F); the row last entered comes back as the top row (FUN_101f7080). Enter opens the stage's
  window (table 0x103854f4; dried plnt6; from stage 12 gardening ends); Escape ends gardening (myroom's menu again).
- plnt1..6 (stacked on the log): Examine (c2s 0x0FD and the moogle's line by stage, one of two at random; dried
  0x8b), Plant Seeds / Feed Crystal (bankmenu, then the seed list (type 11) / crystal list (0x1000..0x1007), moogle
  0x4b / 0x4c; Enter asks 0xc 0x30 / 0x32 with 0x53 / 0x54; Yes c2s 0x0FC), Harvest / Dry Flowers / Empty Pot (0xc
  0x33 / 0x31 / 0x34 with two moogle lines each; Yes c2s 0x0FE flag 0, 0x0FF, 0x0FE flag 1). Any answer brings the
